scope: Exact checkpoint byte audit and local real-weight components. Original Python CPU/MPS model runs succeeded on a tiny fixture; complete frozen-sharing parity belongs to the separate native runtime audit. No broad all-input or biological-quality guarantee.

candidates.scope: Both official inference state dictionaries retained; equal raw tensor bytes stored once. Distinct heads and configurations retained.
candidates.next_test: Validate all shared blobs bytewise and construct both original classes through strict state loading.
candidates.benefit: Potential distribution size reduction; no arithmetic reduction and no resident-memory-sharing claim.

candidates.proof: For u=LN_nonaffine(x), W_i LN_gamma_i,beta_i(x)=(W_i diag(gamma_i))u+W_i beta_i. Concatenate the folded projections.
candidates.contract: Same eps1e-5, frozen inference weights, preserve branch ordering, split atom encoder/decoder output concatenations.
limitations: Floating-point rounding changes for folded projections; local 1e-5 mixed gates pass, no whole-model gate.
Computed once before sample(), not once per denoising step.
Shared-statistics-only retains all weights and was bitwise equal in local CPU/MPS probes.

candidates.proof: 24 token layers share the same time-conditioned s. Each attention and transition AdaLN normalizes that same s with the same eps; nonaffine statistics can be hoisted.
candidates.benefit: 48 condition norms per score-model call can share statistics; nonlinear gates still evaluated.
limitations: Requires a composite transformer adapter and actual-weight/output validation.
Do not collapse gates or activation norms; only condition-input statistics are common.
Time conditioning changes each denoising step, so no arbitrary cross-step output cache.

candidates.proof: 388 atom features are ref_pos3+charge1+element128 one-hot+4 atom-character64 one-hots. A linear splits into a 4D continuous projection plus five categorical column gathers.
candidates.benefit: Avoid dense one-hot input allocation and arithmetic; keeps essentially the same weight values.
limitations: Coordinates/charge are continuous: whole-input finite lookup is invalid.
Must preserve atom feature ordering, padding/masks and all supported element/name categories.
Gathers/sums change float32 addition ordering; full gate required.

candidates.proof: The139-wide input is three categorical one-hot groups plus one boolean; bias-free linear can gather each active column and sum.
candidates.benefit: Avoid O(B*N*N*139) one-hot intermediates. Weight count essentially unchanged.
limitations: Must preserve fix_sym_check, cyclic and clipping semantics.

candidates.contract: CLI loads ema=False. on_load_checkpoint only updates training config/optimizer scheduler settings. Source registers output_projection_linear twice; ordinary strict PyTorch loading child alias wins if checkpoint names differ.
limitations: Full byte comparison confirmed equality of all66 source gate alias pairs. A single actual gate also validated strict-load precedence; native model output checks belong to the separate runtime audit.
Affinity ZIP already stores these aliases once.
Dropping training state changes training-resume capability; label inference export.

candidates.reason: Chunked forward directly slices fc1/fc2/fc3.weight; replacing only their child forwards is bypassed.
Optional fused CUDA triangle path reads norm/projection weight attributes directly. Forward-only child replacements do not affect that path.

Token attention uses 768/16=48 features per head; atom attention128/4=32. No Mol-JEPA-like512-wide head fed by82-dimensional features. AdaLN and sigmoid/SiLU gates obstruct simple full-block affine contraction.
